definitions.label: UGV Reset coordinator
definitions.description: The single ground-station Reset coordinator of a Session. It needs no roster: every vehicle declares its footprint, limits, target and health in its own Reset session message, and the coordinator grants routes verified against the declared footprints, the Scene and the world boundary. It does not subscribe /command and does not publish cmd_vel. Started by the Session-managed system workflow xgc.system.ground-control.

fence.description: The Session's frozen world control bounds as "x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max" in meters; empty: no fence.

sceneNamespace.description: ROS namespace of the Scene adapter (for example /xgc_scene) when the Experiment authors a Scene; empty: no Scene, routes are only kept clear of the vehicles and the fence.
